name: Ex-Studio Junior
desc: Ten years you served in the mailroom, the anteroom and on the sets of a big studio. You know the hallways, the names — and the shortcuts.

trait.de: House scent: studio dinners are one and a half times as effective.

weakness.de: The indie scene considers you a corporate creature.

name: Gossip Columnist
desc: For years you wrote for the gossip columns. You know every doorman, every dresser — and every skeleton in this town's closets.

trait.de: Ear to the town: new rumors reach you instantly, press work already counts from 1 slot.

weakness.de: The studios don't quite trust you.

name: Lawyer
desc: You drafted contracts, picked them apart and saved them. Now you sit on the other side of the table — with reserves and a reputation for watertight clauses.

trait.de: Watertight: your contract offers come across far more convincing.

weakness.de: Paragraphs instead of gut feeling: your instinct starts lower.

name: Failed Actor
desc: Three auditions away from the breakthrough that never came. You know how your clients' dreams feel — you had the same ones.

trait.de: Empathy: you read talent more precisely (tighter grade spreads) and gain trust faster (×1.25).

weakness.de: People remember your flops — your reputation starts lower.

name: Self-Made Climber
desc: From paperboy to businessman — nobody gave you anything. Your capital is real; your name just doesn't mean anything in Bel Air yet.

trait.de: Every dollar counts: office costs permanently −10%.

weakness.de: A-listers demand extra reputation from upstarts (+5).
